configurations.//: The same server, bound to every interface so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can reach it. Vite binds 127.0.0.1 ONLY by default, which is why http://<your-ip>:5173 times out with no error anywhere -- nothing is listening on that address. NOT autoPort: the URL is being read off a screen and typed into a phone, so the port has to be the one the doc says. See docs/notes/mobile.md.
configurations.name: katana-kitties-lan
